title: Reports of Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act Offences Related to COVID-19
what_it_is: Reports of Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act Offences Related to COVID-19

sections.label: POFMA COVID-19 reports 2020-2022
sections.summary: Between 2020 and 2022, four POFMA cases with seven directions arose from public feedback on COVID-19 falsehoods redirected to the POFMA Office.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information in each of the years between 2020 and 2022 (a) how many POFMA reports are received by the various Ministries that relate to COVID-19; and (b) how many of such reports resulted in no further action being taken.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister f or Communications and Information)
sentences.text: This included public feedback to various Government agencies on potential COVID-19 falsehoods that were redirected to the POFMA Office.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister f or Communications and Information)
sentences.text: There were four POFMA cases involving the issuance of seven POFMA directions that were linked to such public feedback.

sections.label: COVID-19 misinformation public communication
sections.summary: The Government used public communication and education, including Gov.sg's WhatsApp channel, to provide accurate COVID-19 information alongside POFMA directions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Government took and continues to treat COVID-19 misinformation very seriously, even if the feedback did not result in a POFMA action.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As a result, other than the POFMA direction, the Government has also used public communication and education efforts to provide accurate and timely information relating to COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This includes, providing up-to-date information directly to Singaporeans through various channels, such as the Gov.sg's WhatsApp channel, which grew to over 1.2 million subscribers during the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Some of our polls in 2022 show that three in four members of the public think that the Government has provided sufficient information on COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: A 2021 survey showed that over 86% agreed that these messages helped in their decision to get vaccinated.
